args.subject: Resume Template
args.body:
Hi Alice,

As requested, I'm sending you the resume template. Since I couldn't directly access the website due to tool limitations, I've created a professional resume template with standard sections that you can customize.

The template includes:
- Contact information section
- Professional summary
- Work experience section
- Education section
- Skills section
- Certifications section

You can download this file and fill in your own details. If you need the specific template from the website, you might need to try accessing it from another device or contact the website directly.

Best regards,
Emma
